name: Nice Price Editor
author: taraskinsdev

sections.description:
Nice Price Editor adds an admin page for bulk editing product prices in WooCommerce.

Features:
* Category filter for products
* Edit prices for simple and variable products
* AJAX updates without page reload

Requires WooCommerce 6.0+.

Usage

  1. Open “Nice Price Editor” in the WordPress admin.
  2. Select a product category if needed.
  3. Enter a new price and click “Save”.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nice-price-editor folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in the WordPress admin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
